Will it work with my car?
Yes, if your car uses Type 2, which most UK electric and plug-in hybrid cars do.
How long does installation take?
Most standard installs happen within 10 days of your survey being approved, and in as little as 48 to 96 hours in selected areas.
Do I need a home visit?
Usually not. We check your home remotely using photos or a video call.
Can I pay in instalments?
Yes. Pay in full, or spread the cost with Klarna or PayPal Pay in 3, subject to status.
Where do you install?
Across England, with the rest of the UK coming soon.
